components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default operational action button bound to the active dashboard accent palette.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--accent-primary, #1d4ed8); color: var(--accent-ink, #ffffff); font-family: var(--font-sans, Poppins, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-primary-hover, #1e40af); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet secondary control for filters, exports, and cancel actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #cbd5e1); background: var(--surface-canvas, #f8fafc); color: var(--ink-primary, #0f172a); font-family: var(--font-sans, Poppins, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-subtle, #f1f5f9); border-color: var(--border-strong, #94a3b8); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-primary, #1d4ed8); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Editorial Pill CTA
components.description: High-contrast monochrome pill button reserved for public landing and auth surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: none; background: #0d0d0f; color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-sans, Poppins, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgb(11 11 13 / 0.25); transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-pill:hover { background: #27272a; transform: scale(1.02); } .ds-btn-pill:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0d0d0f; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Crisp, unadorned form input with clear focus halo and accessible validation states.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-family: var(--font-sans, Poppins, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-secondary, #334155); } .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #94a3b8); background: transparent; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-primary, #0f172a); outline: none; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-muted, #64748b); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent-primary, #1d4ed8); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-primary, #1d4ed8) 22%, transparent); }

components.css: .ds-kpi-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-elevated, #ffffff); color: var(--ink-primary, #0f172a); border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #cbd5e1); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(15 23 42 / 0.06), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.04); font-family: var(--font-sans, Poppins, sans-serif); transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-kpi-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -12px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.16); } .ds-kpi-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-secondary, #334155); } .ds-kpi-delta { font-family: var(--font-mono, Geist Mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--status-success-bg, #ecfdf5); color: var(--status-success-ink, #065f46); } .ds-kpi-value { font-family: var(--font-mono, Geist Mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-kpi-meta { font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-muted, #64748b); }

narrative.overview:
This design system powers a unified SaaS platform for barbershops and beauty salons across Brazil and Venezuela, balancing two distinct yet cohesive registers. Public and authentication surfaces use a crisp monochrome editorial voice that communicates immediate clarity and trust, while operational dashboards (/owner/* and /collaborator/*) act as a calm, ultra-legible control desk where scheduling, finances, comandas, commissions, and inventory coexist without visual noise.

Precision and serenity govern every control. Buttons feel compact and grounded, cards rest cleanly against a cool neutral canvas with restrained hairline borders, and form inputs stay sharp and unadorned so numerical data, appointment times, and operational statuses remain the focal point. Elevation is subtle and selective—flat surfaces form the base while soft shadows lift financial cards, KPI summaries, and active operational blocks to establish clear visual hierarchy.

Decorative gradients, heavy drop shadows, oversaturated cards, and unnecessary chrome are explicitly rejected. Every surface maintains strict consistency across Light and Dark modes and honors all eleven user-selectable dashboard accent palettes without sacrificing WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
keyCharacteristics: Calm, uncluttered operational density: High-information financial and scheduling screens remain scannable and fast rather than overloaded.
Dual-register coherence: Fixed monochrome editorial identity on landing and auth; customizable Light/Dark + 11-palette system inside dashboards.
Subtle, selective elevation: Flat tonal canvas paired with soft shadows only on financial KPIs, key operational blocks, hover states, and overlays.
Precision tabular data: Monospace tabular-nums alignment for all hours, prices, durations, and commissions.
Accessible by construction: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, icons paired with every status color, 44px mobile touch targets, and strict prefers-reduced-motion compliance.

rules.name: The Palette-Respect Rule
rules.body: Dashboard components must always consume semantic tokens (--accent-primary, --surface-elevated, --ink-primary, --border-subtle) rather than hardcoded palette hex values, so all 11 user palettes and Light/Dark modes stay consistent everywhere.

rules.name: The Icon-Plus-Color Rule
rules.body: Status colors never carry meaning alone; every StatusBadge and agenda status indicator pairs its semantic tint with an explicit icon and text label.

rules.name: The Uncluttered Accent Rule
rules.body: Accent colors mark primary actions, active indicators, and key focus states—never full-bleed saturated card backgrounds or decorative gradients.

rules.name: The Tabular Money & Time Rule
rules.body: Every time slot, currency amount, duration, commission rate, and KPI counter uses Geist Mono with tabular-nums so columns align effortlessly when scanning financial reports or daily agendas.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: Fluid display and section titles apply text-wrap: balance to prevent awkward single-word orphans on narrow mobile screens (320px–390px).

rules.name: The Selective Elevation Rule
rules.body: Use flat tonal borders for routine containers and reserve soft shadows for financial cards, KPI indicators, interactive hover lift, and floating overlays. Never stack heavy drop shadows or colored neon glows.

rules.name: The Quiet Motion Rule
rules.body: Dashboard transitions stay crisp and functional (160ms fast / 260ms base with cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), animating only transform, opacity, and subtle color shifts—and collapsing to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

dos: Do use CSS custom properties (--surface-canvas, --surface-elevated, --accent-primary, --ink-primary, --border-subtle) for every dashboard surface so Light/Dark mode and all 11 palettes work seamlessly.
Do apply Geist Mono with tabular-nums to all times, prices, durations, commissions, and financial KPIs.
Do pair every status color with an icon and text label (StatusBadge pattern) to preserve WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility.
Do apply subtle, selective elevation on financial cards, KPI indicators, and key operational blocks while keeping routine containers flat on the neutral canvas.
Do open contextual dashboard forms in SlideOverDrawer to preserve list context and keep screens calm.
Do keep mobile touch targets at least 44px and honor prefers-reduced-motion on all transitions.
donts: Don't use exaggerated drop shadows, decorative background gradients, or heavily saturated full-card fills inside operational dashboards.
Don't hardcode a single palette hex (e.g., #1d4ed8 or #00a8c6) on themed dashboard controls where --accent-primary belongs.
Don't overload financial or scheduling views with unnecessary widgets, chrome, or visual noise that competes with core numbers and actions.
Don't leak dashboard dark-mode or palette styling onto the fixed monochrome editorial landing and auth pages (/, /login, /register).
Don't convey appointment or financial status by color alone without an accompanying icon or label.
